articles.headline: Week 2 winners and losers: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, CeeDee Lamb shine; Bijan Robinson struggles
articles.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba and CeeDee Lamb came up big in Week 2, while Bijan Robinson and Justin Jefferson had very quiet days.
articles.body:
Week 2 of the 2026 fantasy football season wasn't the high-scoring bonanza of Week 1, but Jaxon Smith-Njigba, CeeDee Lamb and DeVonta Smith all came up big. On the flip side, fantasy stars Bijan Robinson, Justin Jefferson and Drake London all had disappointing games.

Who were the big winners and losers around the league during the second week of the fantasy football season?

Matt Bowen and Tristan H. Cockcroft offer their analysis.

Jump to a topic:

Ranking winners | Ranking losers 

Biggest injuries and what's next

Ranking fantasy winners of Week 2

1. Jaxon Smith-Njigba, WR, Seattle Seahawks

After a stellar, breakthrough 2025 that saw him score the second-most fantasy points among wide receivers, it might be shocking to learn that this week's 42.5 points set Smith-Njigba's new personal best. He flashed good chemistry with fill-in quarterback Drew Lock and was productive at all levels of the field. This was vintage JSN, and we should see something similar in a great Week 3 matchup against the Washington Commanders. -- Cockcroft

2. Dak Prescott, QB, CeeDee Lamb, WR, and Jake Ferguson, TE, Dallas Cowboys

In a positive matchup versus the Commanders, the Cowboys had multiple Week 2 winners. Prescott had 29.76 points, attacking every level of the field in the pass game, finishing with 279 yards and four touchdowns, while adding 26 yards on the ground. Lamb's 35.3 points were the second most among wide receivers through the late window. Lamb caught 8 of 9 targets for 153 yards and added two scores. And don't forget about Ferguson in scoring position. The tight end caught all four of his targets for 43 yards, with two touchdown grabs on red zone throws (20.3 points). Because of his red zone usage, Ferguson will stay in the lower-tier TE1 mix for the Week 3 matchup versus Baltimore. -- Bowen

3. DeVonta Smith, WR, Philadelphia Eagles

If he's destined for a breakout, fantasy WR1-caliber year, this might well be the starting-point game his managers refer to. Smith scored 27.7 fantasy points, his sixth most in 82 career games, and he had a 38% target share. He's in prime position to shine, with A.J. Brown now in New England, and he'll get a fantastic Week 3 matchup in which to potentially repeat the effort versus the Chicago Bears. -- Cockcroft

4. Tyler Shough, QB, and Chris Olave, WR, New Orleans Saints

The Shough-Olave combination produced high-end numbers again in the Week 2 win over the Ravens. Shough (22.38 points) threw for 252 yards and a touchdown, while he rushed for 23 yards and another score on nine carries. That's two straight games for Shough with at least 22 points. Olave caught 8 of a team-high 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown, which was good for 22.6 points -- after dropping 28.2 points on the Lions in Week 1. Olave will remain a midtier WR1 for me in the ranks for the Week 3 matchup versus the Raiders, while Shough should be viewed as a fringe QB1. -- Bowen

articles.headline: Deshaun Watson makes case in Browns win with job on line
articles.description: With rumblings about his starting job being on the line, quarterback Deshaun Watson responded with maybe his best game as a Cleveland Brown.
articles.body:
TAMPA, Fla. -- With rumblings about his starting job being on the line, quarterback Deshaun Watson responded with maybe his best game as a Cleveland Brown.

Watson completed 24 of 30 passes for 238 yards and two touchdowns, including the go-ahead score, as the Browns upset the Buccaneers 23-19 on the road.

The victory marked Watson's first win as a starter since Week 2 of the 2024 season. Prior to Sunday's win, Watson had lost six straight starts, the longest active streak by a quarterback in the league. And after a poor performance in a Week 1 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars -- Watson's first regular season start since an Achilles injury that sidelined him for all of the 2025 season -- Watson and Browns coach Todd Monken were peppered with questions about the veteran quarterback's job security.

On Sunday morning, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported that no firm decision had been made for Week 3, and that the belief was the first two games would serve as a natural evaluation point for the team's quarterback situation.

Watson, though, brought the Browns back from a 16-6 second-half deficit with a performance that will likely him keep him in the starting spot ahead of the Browns' home opener against the Carolina Panthers in Week 3.

When asked if Watson will start next Sunday, Monken said: "I'm going to enjoy this win. And I thought he played his a-- off. I'm so happy for him. I'm just going to leave it there, right? I mean, good for him. Good for 22 months working his [butt] off to get to where he's at. I'm going to leave it at that."

Watson's 238 passing yards were his third most as a Brown. His 121.9 passer rating was also his third-highest mark in a Cleveland uniform. Sunday's game marked the first time the Browns scored at least 20 points in a Watson start since Week 10 of the 2023 season, snapping a streak of eight straight Watson starts without breaking 20 points.

"Every week I'm getting more confident and more comfortable with myself," Watson said. "Like I told the team, I feel good. I'm healthy. I trust the work that I've put in the last two years and [if] you got to put the ball in my hands, I'm ready for it.

"So whatever we got to do to make the team win and keep the guys moving, I'm ready for it."

The Browns trailed 9-6 at halftime and had just 59 net yards after two quarters, but Watson picked things up in the second half. In the final two quarters, Watson completed 17 of 21 passes for 183 yards and two touchdowns. He also led the Browns with 22 rushing yards in the game.

On the go-ahead touchdown drive, Watson threw a 17-yard score to tight end Blake Whiteheart to put the Browns up with 3:51 remaining. Watson converted four third downs on the drive.

Cleveland's victory was delayed at the 2-minute warning by a 2 hour and 12-minute suspension because of lightning, but after the break, a red zone defensive stand secured the victory for the Browns.

articles.headline: NFL Week 2's best arrivals, led by Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes
articles.description: Rounding up the top pregame and tunnel arrivals from around the league.
articles.body:
There are no rules for the best NFL gameday arrival fits, but there is certainly an unspoken competition, and the judges are often a player's football peers.

An animated discussion among Cincinnati Bengals defenders in the locker room after a win illustrated this.

The source was cornerback DJ Turner II's custom bold double-breasted suit by fashion designer Pharoah Kirk -- the unofficial fit of the day. Respect was given to Turner's fit, with one player promising to top his arrival the following week.

"I'm always about that action," Turner said. I gotta put it on."

Week 1 started with a bang, as many players put on their Sunday best to open the season, but just like on the field, consistency is king. This Sunday could provide much stiffer competition.

Here are some of the most interesting NFL arrivals from Week 2.

Sunday night drip

Indianapolis Colts defensive lineman DeForest Buckner may have had the best outfit ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs. Buckner wore a navy and black silk suit made by Gentleman's Playbook. It was a bold and unique choice.

Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce also showed up in style with a Louis Vuitton collarless jacket and matching belt. His teammate, Patrick Mahomes, rocked Adidas from head to toe with Oakley sunglasses.

Here are the top fits ahead of "Sunday Night Football."

Sunday afternoon arrivals

Dallas Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens kept it simple up top, with a pop of color below for his arrival ahead of a divisional game against the Washington Commanders on Sunday. Pickens wore a solid black T-shirt, multicolored striped shorts, and purple-and-black Nike Dunks on the feet.

Commanders' rookie linebacker Sonny Styles was among the best dressed players during the arrivals for the Sunday afternoon games. Styles arrived in a grey suit, with his initials embroidered on the collar in gold.

Here are more notable arrivals from the 4 p.m. slate:

Best of 1 p.m. arrivals

Cincinnati Bengals defensive lineman Myles Murphy was the best dressed during Sunday's early slate. Murphy arrived wearing a Gallery Department Logan canvas trucker vest with black cargo pants. His Bottega Veneta woven duffle bag was a strong complementary piece.

Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield was dressed to impress, arriving for a home game against his former team, the Cleveland Browns. Mayfield wore a cream polo with khaki and green striped and white shoes.

Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson wore a red letterman jacket and loose-fit khaki pants ahead of a road matchup against the Chicago Bears.

Here are some of the other memorable fits from Sunday's 1 p.m. slate:

Thursday night's best fit

To kick off Week 2, Buffalo Bills edge rusher Bradley Chubb arrived in a plaid Archival button-down shirt paired with dark denim jeans.

articles.headline: White Sox keep pace in the AL Central with a rain-soaked 8-1 win over the Tigers
articles.description: — Sam Antonacci had a two-run double in a three-run fourth inning and the Chicago White Sox kept pace in the AL Central and eliminated the Detroit Tigers from playoff contention with a rain-soaked 8-1 victory Sunday.
articles.body:
CHICAGO -- — Sam Antonacci had a two-run double in a three-run fourth inning and the Chicago White Sox kept pace in the AL Central and eliminated the Detroit Tigers from playoff contention with a rain-soaked 8-1 victory Sunday.


              The White Sox remained a game behind the Cleveland Guardians in the division and hold a three-game lead over the Houston Astros and Toronto Blue Jays for the third wild card.


              The start was delayed 3 hours, 50 minutes by rain and most of the game was played in a swirling mist.


              Davis Martin threw 4 1/3 scoreless innings for the White Sox, striking out six, allowing three hits and walking three. He failed to record a win for his 15th straight appearance dating to June 10.


              Huascar Brazoban (6-2), activated from the injured list earlier Sunday, pitched a scoreless sixth for the victory.


              Trevor Richards pitched two innings for the 205th White Sox relief outing of 1 1/3 innings or more, a major league record.


              Braden Montgomery started the scoring with an RBI double in the second. Kyle Teel singled home Antonacci after his double in the fourth. Chase Meidroth hit his 15th home run in the fifth, a two-run shot into the left-field bullpen.


              Max Clark broke up the shutout with a sacrifice fly in the top of the eighth.


              Detroit reliever Brant Hurler walked in a run in the bottom of the inning and Randal Grichuk followed with a sacrifice fly to make it 8-1.


              Detroit starter Troy Melton (8-5) allowed three runs on four hits and three walks in 3 2/3 innings before leaving with a trainer after Antonacci's double.


              Eduardo Valencia had three hits for the Tigers.


              Up next
              The Tigers have not announced a starter for Monday's opener of a three-game series against Washington. The White Sox are off Monday before before beginning a three-game series at Kansas City, with LHP Anthony Kay (9-9, 4.41 ERA) starting Tuesday against LHP Daniel Lynch IV (6-6, 3.29).


              ------

シカゴ -- サム・アントナッチが3点を奪った4回の攻撃で2点適時二塁打を放ち、シカゴ・ホワイトソックスはア・リーグ中地区での上位争いを維持するとともに、雨に見舞われた日曜日の一戦に8-1で勝利してデトロイト・タイガースをプレーオフ争いから脱落させました。

ホワイトソックスは同地区首位のクリーブランド・ガーディアンズと1ゲーム差を維持し、第3のワイルドカード枠を争うヒューストン・アストロズとトロント・ブルージェイズに対して3ゲーム差のリードを保っています。

試合開始は雨のため3時間50分遅れ、試合の大部分は渦巻く霧雨の中で行われました。

ホワイトソックスのデイビス・マーティンは4回1/3を投げて6奪三振、3安打、3四球の無失点に抑えましたが、6月10日以来となる15試合連続で勝ち星を挙げることができませんでした。

日曜日の試合前に故障者リストから復帰したウアスカル・ブラゾバン（6勝2敗）が6回を無失点に抑えて勝ち投手となりました。

トレバー・リチャーズは2回を投げ、ホワイトソックスの救援陣として今季205回目となる1回1/3以上の登板を記録し、メジャー記録を更新しました。

ブレイデン・モンゴメリーが2回にタイムリー二塁打を放ち先制。カイル・ティールは4回にアントナッチの二塁打の後にタイムリーを放ちました。チェイス・メイドロスは5回に左翼ブルペンへ打ち込む15号2ランを放ちました。

マックス・クラークは8回表に犠牲フライを放ち、完封負けを免れました。

デトロイトの救援投手ブラント・ハラーは8回裏に押し出しの四球を与え、続くランダル・グリチックが犠牲フライを放ち8-1としました。

デトロイトの先発トロイ・メルトン（8勝5敗）は、3回2/3を投げて4安打、3四球、3失点とし、アントナッチの二塁打の後にトレーナーとともに降板しました。

タイガースのエドゥアルド・バレンシアは3安打を記録しました。

次節
タイガースは月曜日から始まるワシントンとの3連戦初戦の先発投手を発表していません。ホワイトソックスは月曜日がオフとなり、火曜日からカンザスシティでの3連戦に臨みます。火曜日は左腕アンソニー・ケイ（9勝9敗、防御率4.41）と左腕ダニエル・リンチIV（6勝6敗、防御率3.29）が先発予定です。

------

articles.headline: Michael Carrick keen to find Man United positives, but there aren't many right now
articles.description: This is Man United's worst start in a Premier League season in 12 years. Is there any reason to believe a turnaround is ahead?
articles.headlineJa: マイケル・キャリック、マンUのポジティブな面を見出そうとするも現在は好材料が乏しい状況
articles.descriptionJa: これはマンチェスター・ユナイテッドにとって過去12年間で最悪のプレミアリーグ開幕スタートとなった。巻き返しを信じられる理由は何かあるのだろうか？
articles.body:
LONDON -- For Michael Carrick, the international break won't feel like much of a break at all.

The games will stop, but after Manchester United's 1-1 draw with Fulham on Sunday, the spotlight and the scrutiny will remain. It's going to be a long three weeks for United's coach.

It could have been even worse. Matheus Cunha's 89th-minute equalizer prevented a first defeat at Craven Cottage in 17 years and stopped the pressure on Carrick ramping up to another level.

After back-to-back home defeats to Manchester City and Brighton, three consecutive losses would have left United's decision-makers with some thinking to do while the players jet off to join their national teams.

As it is, a point at Fulham will at least stop the bleeding -- there's not much to shout about. Five points from five games is United's worst start to a Premier League season for more than a decade. And that's after a run of fixtures that appeared on paper to be relatively manageable.

"It's not been ideal," Carrick admitted. "I know we can do better, we need to do better at certain things. But at the same time, I'm not despondent and down because I think we're showing some good signs as well.

"I'm not playing it down. We wanted more points from it."

Though Carrick was keen to find the positives, the most damning part of the day was perhaps the assessment of his former United teammate Gary Neville. The pair played together at Old Trafford for four years, but when Fulham went ahead midway through the second half, Neville did not hold back.

"I've watched Manchester United since the age of 5," he said. "That's the worst 15 minutes I've ever seen them play."

Given some of the disastrous displays over the past decade, it was quite a statement. Neville's outburst -- during which he branded parts of the performance as "pathetic" -- was prompted by a calamitous Fulham goal.

Kobbie Mainoo's pass into midfield was telegraphed by Calvin Bassey, who was too strong for Cunha. Then the Fulham defender was allowed to advance unchallenged into the penalty area before firing a tame shot at Senne Lammens.

But when things aren't going well, even the most innocuous situations can turn into something else. This time, Bassey's shot hit Lammens before rebounding back toward the goal off Lisandro Martínez.

A scrambling Lammens chose to use his feet rather than his hands to stop the ball and succeeded only in booting it into the net. It was either bad luck or symptomatic of a United team struggling with the confidence to make decisive decisions.

Self-belief, or lack of it, is not the only issue for Carrick to address. There's a feeling among some fans that United have not looked fit enough during the early part of the season.

Running stats aren't everything, but at the end of the 90 minutes, Fulham's players had covered an extra 6 kilometers more than United's players. There were certainly times during the game when it appeared obvious that the home side was quicker, faster and sharper.

Cunh
articles.bodyJa:
ロンドン -- マイケル・キャリックにとって、インターナショナルブレイク（代表戦期間）はとても「ブレイク（休日）」と感じられるものではないでしょう。

試合は中断しますが、日曜日のマンチェスター・ユナイテッド対フラム戦が1-1の引き分けに終わったことで、注目と厳しい視線は注がれ続けます。ユナイテッドの指揮官にとって長い3週間になりそうです。

さらに悪化していた可能性もありました。89分のマテウス・クーニャの同点ゴールにより、クラベン・コテージでの17年ぶりの敗戦を免れ、キャリックにかかるプレッシャーがさらなる高まりを見せるのを阻止しました。

マンチェスター・シティとブライトンにホームで連敗した後の3連敗となれば、選手たちが代表チームへ合流するために飛び立つ間、ユナイテッドの経営陣は重大な決断を迫られていたはずです。

現状、フラム戦での勝ち点1は少なくとも流血を止めた格好ですが、喜べる内容はほとんどありません。開幕5試合で勝ち点5という成績は、ユナイテッドにとってここ10年以上で最悪のプレミアリーグスタートとなりました。しかも、紙の上では比較的戦いやすいと思われていた日程での結果です。

「理想的ではない」とキャリックは認めました。「もっとうまくやれるはずだし、いくつかの点では改善が必要です。しかし同時に、良い兆候も見られているので、絶望して落ち込んでいるわけではありません」

「事態を軽視しているわけではありません。もっと勝ち点を取りたかったのです」

キャリックはポジティブな要素を見出そうとしていましたが、この日最も手厳しい評価を下したのは、ユナイテッドでの元チームメイトであるゲイリー・ネヴィルだったかもしれません。2人はオールド・トラッフォードで4年間共にプレーしましたが、後半半ばにフラムが先制した際、ネヴィルは容容赦なく批判しました。

「私は5歳の頃からマンチェスター・ユナイテッドを見ている」と彼は語りました。「あれは私が今まで見た中で最悪の15分間のプレーだった」

過去10年間の惨憺たるパフォーマンスの数々を考えれば、これは相当な発言です。ネヴィルがパフォーマンスの一部を「情けない」と断じたこの怒りは、フラムの酷いゴールによって引き起こされました。

コビー・メイヌーの中盤へのパスはカルビン・バッシーに読まれ、バッシーはクーニャを力でねじ伏せました。その後、このフラムのディフェンダーは誰にも阻まれることなくペナルティエリアまで侵入し、センネ・ラメンスに向かって力のないシュートを放ちました。

しかし、上手くいっていない時には、ごくありふれた状況でさえトラブルへと発展してしまいます。今回、バッシーのシュートはラメンスに当たった後、リサンドロ・マルティネスに跳ね返ってゴールへと向かいました。

慌てたラメンスは手ではなく足を使ってボールを止めようとしましたが、結果的にボールをネットに蹴り込んでしまいました。不運だったのか、あるいは決定的な判断を下す自信を失っているユナイテッドというチームを象徴していたのか。

自信の欠如だけが、キャリックが取り組むべき問題ではありません。一部のファンからは、シーズン序盤のユナイテッドは運動量が十分ではないように見えるという声も上がっています。

走行距離のデータがすべてではありませんが、90分終了時点で、フラムの選手たちはユナイテッドの選手たちよりも6キロ多く走っていました。試合中、ホームチームの方が素早く、速く、鋭く見えた瞬間が確かに存在したのです。

クーニャ
